Elena (Finance): Morning — noticed a $7.2k unassigned GPU line on the monthly export. Looks like APAC spot rebalancer ran and credits/charges didn't map to teams. Can infra confirm?
Marco (Eng-Infra): Saw that. The rebalancer moved ~30 T4 instances from us-east1 to asia-south1 during maintenance. Labels were present on pods but VM-level `costCenter` label was dropped during the reattach flow.
Deepa (ML Platform): That was our workload. We used the spot-rebalance feature to reduce latency. We definitely set costCenter=ml-research, but if it got dropped it's on infra side.
BillingBot (billing-bot): Automated alert: 1795000500-1795001500  GCP adjustment: 30 x T4 preemptible moved, unresolved labels detected, unresolved_amount=$7200, line_items=project=ml-research-sweeps, labels_missing=[costCenter].
Elena (Finance): For month close we need a reallocation method. Options: internal ledger reclass or request vendor on-invoice adjustment. Which is faster?
Marco (Eng-Infra): Internal ledger reclass is fastest. We can attribute by instance runtime per job id. I can pull the instance-to-job mapping from the rebalancer logs and produce a distribution csv.
Deepa (ML Platform): We'll accept the internal reclass but want a remediation plan so this doesn't repeat. Also want a signal when rebalancer moves >5 gpus across regions without preserving costCenter.
Elena (Finance): OK. Please: 1) Marco produce distribution csv and attach ticket, 2) Infra add alert + PR for label preservation, 3) Finance will create provisional journal entry JRN-2026-04-12-RB to push $7,200 to ML Platform pending vendor response.
Marco (Eng-Infra): Will do. Ticket INF-9521 opened. Uploading mapping file to drive: /finance/chargebacks/rebalancer-1795001111.csv. PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-ops/pull/833 (label-preserve on detach). Alert created: alert/gpu_rebalancer_label_drift threshold=5.
BillingBot (billing-bot): Action logged: provisional_reclass=true; suggested_owner=ml-platform; ticket=INF-9521.
Elena (Finance): Thanks — I'll record the provisional journal and mark as pending. Deepa, please confirm receipt of the distribution csv so we can finalize chargeback next week.
Deepa (ML Platform): Received. We'll review and confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Elena (Finance): Closing thread for now — will finalize ledger once infra and ML confirm.
